Title: Generally available: Azure Databricks in West US 3

Body.Content:
Azure Databricks is a data analytics platform optimized for the Microsoft Azure cloud services platform. Azure Databricks offers three environments for developing data intensive applications: Databricks SQL, Databricks Data Science & Engineering, and Databricks Machine Learning.

Azure Databricks is now generally available in West US 3. For more information about Azure Databricks, please check out Azure Databricks documentation.
